NFL DFS Tight End Rankings: Week 8 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 1 · 11 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 30, 10:35 PM ET

Trey McBride is the top-projected tight end on the Week 8 DraftKings main slate at 18.6 DraftKings points for $7,400, at Dallas. Brock Bowers (16.4, $7,600) and Sam LaPorta (12.6, $5,100) are next.

Tyler Higbee returns the most per dollar among tight ends projected for at least 7 points: 2.78 projected points per $1,000 at $3,800.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 30, 10:35 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Tight ends to know in Week 8

Trey McBride, ARI at DAL ($7,400)

Trey McBride carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 18.6 DraftKings points at $7,400. That is 2.2 points clear of Brock Bowers. The model gives him 11.0 targets on 39.9 routes. The salary works out to 2.51 projected points per $1,000, 7th of 19 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations McBride averaged 18.6 points with a simulated floor of 4.5 and a ceiling of 46.1, and he holds 12% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Arizona is a 7-point underdog on the road against Dallas, with an implied team total of 23.75 in a game totaled at 54.5.

Brock Bowers, LV at NYJ ($7,600)

Brock Bowers projects 2nd at the position with 16.4 DraftKings points at $7,600. The model gives him 7.7 targets on 32.0 routes. The salary works out to 2.16 projected points per $1,000, 14th of 19 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Bowers averaged 16.3 points with a simulated floor of 3.5 and a ceiling of 42.2, and he holds 6% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Las Vegas is a 1.5-point underdog on the road against the Jets, with an implied team total of 22 in a game totaled at 45.5.

Value: Tyler Higbee, LAR vs LAC ($3,800)

Tyler Higbee projects for 10.6 DraftKings points at $3,800, which works out to 2.78 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 19 tight ends the model projects for 7 or more points. The model gives him 4.2 targets on 20.4 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Higbee averaged 10.7 points with a simulated floor of 0.3 and a ceiling of 32.4, and he holds 8% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Rams are a 6.5-point favorite at home against the Chargers, with an implied team total of 26 in a game totaled at 45.5.
